name: bible-semantic-graph
description: Personal knowledge-graph CMS centered on the Bible. See CONTEXT.md and docs/adr/.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n app,api,pipe -c blue,magenta,green --kill-others-on-fail "bun run dev:app" "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:pipe"
scripts.dev:api: cd sidecar && uv run granian --interface asgi --reload api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 7655
scripts.dev:pipe: cd sidecar && uv run python -m pipeline.watch
scripts.ingest: cd sidecar && uv run python -m pipeline.ingest
scripts.validate: cd sidecar && uv run python -m pipeline.validate
scripts.analyze: cd sidecar && uv run python -m pipeline.analyze
scripts.check-bodies: cd sidecar && uv run python scripts/check_body_lengths.py
scripts.build: bun run validate && bun run ingest && cd app && bun run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n app,api -c blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "cd app && PORT=7654 HOST=0.0.0.0 bun ./build/index.js" "cd sidecar && uv run granian --interface asgi api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 7655"
